title: DifficultyPreset
description: AI difficulty preset shape. Two registry shapes are accepted: (1) the M2 baseline shape with three legacy ids (cakewalk / tough_crowd / veteran) and the M2 tuning fields; (2) the M7 extension shape with archetype_id + difficulty_id keys and 5 archetypes x 3 difficulties = 15 entries, each carrying the M7 spec fields cover_seek_radius / retreat_hp_threshold / squad_comm_delay_ticks plus the M2 fields. Mods supply additional entries at the same path. cf-mod validate keeps both shapes alive so existing M2 mods do not break.

id.description: Stable preset id. M2 baseline shape uses one of cakewalk / tough_crowd / veteran; M7 extension shape uses an <archetype_id>_<difficulty_id> composite (e.g. `rifleman_cakewalk`).

archetype_id.description: M7 extension: which of the five enemy archetypes this preset tunes.

difficulty_id.description: M7 extension: which of the three difficulty bands this preset belongs to.

retreat_hp_threshold.description: M7: fraction of max HP at which the archetype prefers retreat over engagement. Spec range 0.15..=0.50.

cover_seek_radius.description: M7: world-unit search radius the archetype scans for cover after taking fire. Larger values favour high-ground / long sight lines (Sniper); smaller values favour aggressive close-quarters commitment (Assault).

squad_comm_delay_ticks.description: M7: per-archetype radio relay latency in sim ticks (baseline 60 Hz). Lower values mean faster squad-wide threat propagation.
